correctness.rationale: For w_j=1+α/j+c_j/√j with 0≤α≤1 and bounded zero-mean periodic |c_j|≤1/2, weights are positive. Taylor expansion gives log w_j=c_j j^{−1/2}+(α−c_j²/2)/j+O(j^{−3/2}) uniformly in j large. Periodicity and zero mean make the c and c²−v partial sums uniformly bounded, so Abel summation yields uniform all-start/all-length log product δ log((k+n)/k)+O(k^{−1/2}), δ=α−v/2, plus finite positive correction limit L_k. The orbit identity ||Tⁿx||²=Σ|x_k|²P_{k,n}² and dominated convergence give δ>0 divergence of every nonzero orbit, δ<0 strong convergence to 0 but failure of uniform decay on any fixed bounded-orbit ball by far-out e_k, and δ=0 strictly positive finite norms. T is a compact perturbation of the unilateral shift; Fredholm index −1 inside the disk, absence of eigenvectors, growth-bound spectral radius 1 and long approximate unit-circle blocks give σ=closed disk, σ_point=∅, σ_approx=unit circle. Independently recomputed logarithmic drift/residual stabilization for alternating perturbations across δ signs; these finite diagnostics are not proofs.
